name: Rêver
source:
Evening paints the crime scene in crimson. Trees loom, hushed and watchful. The tape catches the wind, trembling like a warning. Something hidden is surfacing; though some would rather it remain forgotten.

[From [url=https://samiiart.itch.io/rever]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
傍晚将犯罪现场涂成深红色。树木若隐若现，安静而警惕。胶带随风颤抖，像是在发出警告。一些隐藏的东西正在浮出水面；尽管有些人宁愿它被遗忘。

[来自[url=https://samiiart.itch.io/rever]Itch.io[/url]]
